ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.
